title: Full Body Gym
author: Yasmin C.
desc: An efficient full-body strength session that hits every major muscle group in one workout, ideal for busy weeks. It builds the lower body with dumbbell squats, leg press, and barbell hip thrusts for the quads and glutes, then works the back with lat pulldowns and dumbbell rows, and the shoulders with seated dumbbell presses. Leg extensions and leg curls finish off the quads and hamstrings. With steady 12–15 rep sets throughout, it builds muscle, strength, and endurance, and it suits beginners through experienced lifters.
